description: We are a multidisciplinary team passionate about technology, science, and space exploration. Our skills include AI, Machine Learning, Software Development, Data Analysis, Hardware, and Engineering. We believe in creativity, collaboration, and critical thinking to turn challenging ideas into innovative solutions. Through NASA’s open data, we aim to explore real-world challenges, learn, innovate, and create projects with meaningful impact.
summary:
Geo Pulse is an interactive environmental platform that transforms Earth science data into accessible insights.

The Problem: Understanding environmental changes is difficult because scientific datasets are complex, and trends vary across time and regions. Yet, these changes affect agriculture, water resources, public health, and urban planning.

Our Solution: Geo Pulse simplifies environmental analysis through interactive maps, visualizations, and statistical tools, using data accessed through NASA's Giovanni platform.

The platform offers two main systems:

• Global Earth Dashboard: A 3D interactive globe and geographic map for exploring temperature, precipitation, and vegetation trends, with regional comparison tools.

• Cairo Climate Analytics: A detailed climate study covering 2000–2025, featuring 9,406 daily records, 51 environmental indicators, and eight specialized analytical pages.

Our Goal:Make Earth science accessible to everyone, especially school and university students, allowing users to explore locations, analyze environmental trends, and understand climate changes without advanced technical knowledge.
details:
Geo Pulse is an interactive, web-based environmental intelligence and educational platform. It turns

Earth observation data and model-derived datasets into visual, explorable and scientifically

interpretable insight, so that anyone curious about our planet can see how environmental conditions

change over time and place.The problem

Earth’s land, atmosphere and vegetation are constantly changing, but the evidence sits inside very large and

technical datasets. Long-term environmental trends are slow, regional, and easily confused with seasonal cycles

and natural variability. Understanding them matters because they inform water planning, agriculture, urban

design, public health and education. Yet scientific files, units, aggregation choices and statistical tests are out of

reach for most people.

What Geo Pulse does

Geo Pulse bridges the gap between raw scientific data and practical environmental understanding. It connects

satellite-based observations and atmospheric model products, accessed through NASA’s Giovanni platform, with

interactive visualization and transparent statistical analysis. The platform offers two integrated experiences:

• Global Earth Dashboard – an interactive 3D Earth, a Leaflet map for choosing regions, time series for Land

Surface Temperature (LST), precipitation and NDVI, trend statistics, and a two-region comparison tool.

• Cairo Climate Analytics – a deep case study of Greater Cairo’s climate built on 9,406 daily records and 51

indicators from January 1, 2000 to October 1, 2025, with eight specialized scientific analysis pages.

Users do not need programming, statistics or Earth-science expertise. They choose a place, pick a variable, adjust

a date range, and read charts that are paired with plain-language interpretation.

Who it is for

Ordinary people and curious citizens, school students, university students and educators, and early-stage analysts

who want to inspect trends, regional contrasts and data-quality checks before committing to deeper analysis.Why the solution is valuable

• Accessible: complex Earth science data becomes interactive and visual.

• Multi-scale: global exploration and a deep city-level case study work together.

• Scientifically careful: trend direction, magnitude and statistical significance are kept distinct;

correlation is never presented as causation.

• Educational: every specialized Cairo page follows a six-step explanatory structure that moves from

chart to takeaway.

• Impactful: it contributes to environmental awareness, scientific literacy and data-driven

decision-making.This guide is written for a judge who has never seen Geo Pulse. It walks through the two experiences

in the order a first-time visitor would naturally explore them, and ends with a short suggested demo

flow.

A. Global Earth Dashboard

A1. Interactive 3D Earth

• A Three.js-powered 3D Earth that users can rotate and explore.

• It introduces the idea of global environmental monitoring: every dataset in the platform describes some part of

this planet.

A2. Interactive Environmental Intelligence Dashboard

• A Leaflet-based interactive map where users select geographical regions.

• Selectable environmental variables include Land Surface Temperature (LST), Precipitation and the

Normalized Difference Vegetation Index (NDVI), a measure of how green and photosynthetically active

vegetation is.

• Each selection produces a time-series visualization and statistical trend analysis, presenting trend direction,

estimated rate of change and statistical-significance indicators where supported by the selected dataset and

analysis method.

A3. Regional Comparison Tool

• Compare two regions for the same variable side by side.

• It shows that one variable can behave differently in different places, building intuition for regional variation in

Earth’s interconnected environmental systems.

A4. About Data

• Explains where the Earth observation data comes from and introduces the scientific methodology.

• Clarifies the difference between correlation and causation, so users interpret results responsibly.

B. Cairo Climate Analytics Platform

A dedicated, detailed case study of Greater Cairo’s climate, designed to show how environmental trends can be

examined in depth once a place and a long record are chosen.
